Welcome to this beautifully appointed Spanish-style condo offering 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 1,591 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space which was the model home from the builder. A spacious front patio welcomes you to the home, with sliding glass doors opening to the lower-level bonus room, currently used as an office. This versatile space features recessed lighting, light LVP flooring, built-in speakers, and direct access to the attached 2-car garage.

Upstairs, the main living level offers an open-concept layout connecting the family room, dining area, and kitchen—ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features crisp white shaker-style cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a 6-burner gas range, clean modern backsplash, and a bar-height peninsula overlooking the dining area. The light LVP flooring, recessed lighting, and built-in speakers continue throughout the main living space. Just off the kitchen, the dedicated laundry room includes a washer and dryer along with additional storage. A door from the kitchen opens to a private balcony, while a convenient half bath with pedestal sink completes this level.

The third level is dedicated to the bedrooms, with carpeting, recessed lighting, and built-in speakers throughout. The spacious primary suite offers abundant natural light, a walk-in closet with built-in storage, and an attached bathroom featuring tile flooring, a dual-sink vanity, separate toilet room, and walk-in shower. Bedrooms two and three are generously sized with great natural light and large closets with sliding doors. A full hall bathroom sits between the bedrooms and features tile flooring, a single-sink vanity, and a tub/shower combination with subway tile surround.

With its flexible lower-level space, open main living area, well-appointed kitchen, spacious bedrooms, and attached 2-car garage, this home offers a comfortable and functional layout with plenty of room to live, work, and entertain.

Back on the market with New Pergo Flooring and Paint!!! Outside, enjoy a welcoming front patio perfect for morning coffee, along with a private backyard offering plenty of space for BBQs, entertaining, gardening, or outdoor play.

Tucked behind the main home is the separate studio, thoughtfully designed with an open living/sleeping area, galley-style kitchen with room for a breakfast table, and an updated full bathroom.

Both units have access to a separate laundry room, providing added convenience while maintaining separation between the living spaces. The fully gated property also includes a large storage shed with possibilities for a workshop, hobby room, playhouse, or additional storage.

Alley access provides convenient access to the rear of the property and additional flexibility for RV or trailer parking. Mature Landscaping and Fruit Trees, ( Avocado, Orange and Lemon)

With two distinct living spaces, updated interiors, new flooring, outdoor areas, and a highly functional front-home/back-home configuration, this Upper Yucaipa property offers flexibility that is hard to find. Move-in ready and ready for its next chapter!

**TWO FLAT PARCELS ARE INCLUDED IN THE SALES PRICE!** 369 Log Lane, featuring the charming mountain cabin, and the adjoining vacant parcel at 375 Log Lane are being sold together, offering approximately 8,300 square feet of combined land. **A charming vintage cabin PLUS an adjoining flat lot — two separate parcels, one sales price, and plenty of possibilities!**

Welcome to peaceful country living in Modoc County Estates! Whether you're looking for a full-time residence, a homestead setup, or a quiet retreat, this property offers endless possibilities in a serene, open setting.

Modern luxury meets iconic mid-century architecture in this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bath Sandpiper residence, tucked within the exclusive Circle 17 enclave. Offering 2,372 square feet, the home pairs contemporary finishes with the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle that defines Palm Desert living.Soaring ceilings, dual-pane windows, and walls of sliding glass create an open, light-filled floor plan. The living room is anchored by a sleek linear fireplace with a custom hearth and striking wood-slat media wall, while the kitchen has been thoughtfully remodeled with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, designer tile, a large island, and high-end stainless steel appliances. The kitchen, dining area, living room, and outdoor patios flow naturally together, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining.The floor plan includes two spacious primary suites with en-suite baths, along with a guest bedroom served by a flexible third bath that functions as either an en suite or guest bath. All three bathrooms feature walk-in showers, and each bedroom offers generous closet space.Oversized 24-by-36-inch tile extends throughout the main living areas and continues onto the patios, creating a seamless transition to the outdoors, while plush carpeting adds warmth and comfort in the bedrooms.The private front courtyard is designed for relaxing with a fire table and adjustable shade coverings. At the rear of the home, the spacious patio enjoys views across the greenbelt, community pool, and surrounding mountains.A private two-car garage, located immediately adjacent to the residence, is a rare and highly desirable Sandpiper amenity.Circle 17 is an intimate enclave of just eight homes arranged around a beautifully landscaped pool, offering an exceptional sense of privacy and tranquility.
